newsitem.title: INDIA: Citibank raises $18 mln loan for Indian Aluminium.
newsitem.headline: Citibank raises $18 mln loan for Indian Aluminium.

text.p: Citibank N.A. on Wednesday said it arranged a $18.0 million foreign currency syndicated loan facility for Indian Aluminium Company Ltd.
The loan is structured with an average tenor of four years and a door-to-door tenor of five years, it said.
The loan would help fund the project-related rupee expenditure of Indian Aluminium under a $3.0 million window government scheme for exporters, the bank said.
Citibank International Plc and Sakura Finance Asia Ltd were joint arrangers for this facility, the bank statement said.
